00072 void TableOscUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00073 { 
00074  float tableSizeOverSampleRate = UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() * wavetableSize;
00075  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00076  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00077  float* freqSamples = inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00078  LOCAL_DECLARE(float, currentPhase);
00079  LOCAL_DECLARE(float, wavetableSize);
00080  
00081  while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00082  {
00083   *outputSamples++ = lookupIndex(currentPhase);
00084   currentPhase += *freqSamples++ * tableSizeOverSampleRate;
00085   
00086   if(currentPhase >= wavetableSize) currentPhase -= wavetableSize;
00087   else if(currentPhase < 0.f)   currentPhase += wavetableSize;
00088  }
00089  
00090  LOCAL_COPY(currentPhase);
00091 }

00102 void TableOscUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00103 { 
00104  const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00105  unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00106  double krBlockSizeOverSampleRate = UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() * krBlockSize;
00107  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00108  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00109  float* freqSamples = inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00110  
00111  int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00112  
00113  while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00114  {
00115   float nextValue = value;
00116   
00117   if(numKrSamples == 0)   
00118   {
00119    nextValue = lookupIndex(currentPhase);
00120    
00121    currentPhase += *freqSamples * krBlockSizeOverSampleRate * wavetableSize;
00122    
00123    while(currentPhase >= wavetableSize) currentPhase -= wavetableSize;
00124    while(currentPhase < 0.f)    currentPhase += wavetableSize;
00125   }
00126   
00127   numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00128   
00129   blockPosition  += numKrSamples;
00130   freqSamples   += numKrSamples;
00131   
00132   if(nextValue == value)
00133   {
00134    while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00135    {
00136     *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00137     --numSamplesToProcess;
00138     --numKrSamples;
00139    }
00140   }
00141   else
00142   {
00143    float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00144    
00145    while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00146    {
00147     *outputSamples++ = value;
00148     value += valueSlope;
00149     --numSamplesToProcess;
00150     --numKrSamples;
00151    }
00152    
00153    value = nextValue;
00154   }
00155  }
00156 }

00159 TableOsc::TableOsc(Buffer const& table, UGen const& freq, Buffer const& initialPhase) throw()
00160 { 
00161  // could check here that the table is padded appropriately and use a less efficient version if not
00162  
00163  int numChannels = ugen::max(freq.getNumChannels(), initialPhase.size());
00164  
00165  initInternal(numChannels);
00166  
00167  for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00168  {
00169   internalUGens[i] = new TableOscUGenInternal(freq, initialPhase.wrapAt(i), table);
00170  }
00171 }

00173 HarmonicOsc::HarmonicOsc(Buffer const& harmonicWeights, UGen const& freq, Buffer const& initialPhase) throw()
00174 { 
00175  int numChannels = ugen::max(freq.getNumChannels(), initialPhase.size());
00176  
00177  initInternal(numChannels);
00178  
00179  Buffer table(BufferSpec(8193, 1, true));
00180  
00181  for(int harmonic = 1; harmonic <= harmonicWeights.size(); harmonic++)
00182  {
00183   float amp = harmonicWeights.getSampleUnchecked(0, harmonic-1);
00184   table += Buffer::line(8193, 0.0, harmonic * twoPi).sin() * amp;
00185  }
00186  
00187  table = table.shrinkSize();
00188  for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00189  {
00190   internalUGens[i] = new TableOscUGenInternal(freq, initialPhase.wrapAt(i), table);
00191  }
00192 }
